resources.string: Paste the app details from Microsoft Entra. Data is encrypted and stored only on this device.
The tenant GUID or domain name
Tenant ID must be a GUID or a domain name
Client ID must be a full 36-character GUID
The Value column, not the Secret ID
UPN of the account that has OneDrive
Keep the app open for a few seconds.
A 6-digit PIN locks the app every time it opens. If you skip it, anyone holding an unlocked device can see your OneDrive. You can turn it on later in Settings › Security.
The Tenant ID format is not valid.
This Client ID does not exist in this tenant.
The Client Secret is incorrect. Check that you copied the Value column, not the Secret ID.
The Client Secret has expired. Create a new secret.
The app is disabled in Entra.
The app has not been granted the Files.Read.All permission, or admin consent has not been granted.
No OneDrive was found for this UPN (wrong UPN, no license, or OneDrive not initialized). Note: the app only supports OneDrive for Business accounts, not personal Microsoft accounts.
Could not connect. Check your network and try again.
Something went wrong. Use the error code below to look it up.
Could not save the connection details
This device could not encrypt and save the connection details. Please try again.
Set a 6-digit PIN so only you can open OneDrive in this app.
That PIN is too easy to guess, choose another one
The two PINs do not match, try again
Use your fingerprint or face to unlock quickly. Your PIN always works, even if your biometrics change. You can turn this on later in Settings › Security.
Could not unlock, please try again
%1$d attempts left before data is erased
Too many wrong attempts, try again later
A PIN cannot be recovered. You need to erase the data on this device and connect OneDrive again from scratch.
Connection details, watch history and settings on this device will be erased. Files on OneDrive are not affected.
